_comment: Scope v1: Greater Manchester (10 metropolitan boroughs, unitary) + Gloucestershire (two-tier: 1 county + 6 districts). Two-tier vs unitary is a real structural difference to call out in analysis, not paper over — GM boroughs run social care/highways themselves, Gloucestershire districts don't.
_note_on_names: Names above are the exact strings as they appear in the MHCLG RS_LA_Data ODS 'Local authority' column, confirmed by direct inspection of data/raw/RS_2024-25.ods on 2026-08-07. Match on these exactly when parsing.
